chunks: Abu Basir asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about the reason for the salat (prayer): how it came to be two rakʿahs and four sajdahs.
He said: “Because one rakʿah from standing is equivalent to two rakʿahs from sitting.”

key_terms.عِلَّةِ: the reason or cause being asked about

ai.seo_question: Why does the prayer consist of two rakʿahs and four prostrations according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a reason concerning the structure of salat (prayer), specifically why it is described as two rakʿahs with four sajdahs. The Imam عليه السلام explains this by stating that one rakʿah performed standing corresponds to two rakʿahs performed sitting, indicating the significance of qiyam within the prayer.
